fullPassage: People seem to recognize that the arts are cultural activities that draw on (or react against) certain cultural traditions, certain shared understanding, and certain values and ideas that are characteristic of the time and place in which the art is created. In the case of science, however, opinions differ. Some scientists, like the great biologist J. B. S. Haldane, see science in a similar light — as a historical activity that occurs in a particular time and place, and that needs to be understood within that context. Others, however, see science as a purely "objective" pursuit, uninfluenced by the cultural viewpoint and values of those who create it. In describing this view of science, philosopher Hugh Lacey speaks of the belief that there is an underlying order of the world which is simply there to be discovered — the world of pure "fact" stripped of any link with value. The aim of science according to this view is to represent this world of pure "fact", independently of any relationship it might bear contingently to human practices and experiences.

❌ ④ pursuit — 추구 (활동이지 의견이 아님)
det.tip: viewpoint = 관점, 견해 (= perspective, point of view)

questions.passage: Others, however, see science as a __________ (pure) "objective" pursuit, uninfluenced by the cultural viewpoint and values of those who create it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 과학을 '순수하게' 객관적인 추구로 본다 → 형용사(objective)를 수식하는 부사 자리이므로 purely
det.analysis: a __________ "objective" pursuit → 형용사(objective)를 수식하는 부사 자리. pure(형용사) → purely(부사)로 변환.

questions.passage: The aim of science according to this view is to represent this world of pure "fact", __________ (independent) of any relationship it might bear contingently to human practices and experiences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 인간의 실천과 경험과의 관계와 '독립적으로' 이 세계를 나타내는 것 → 부사 independently
det.analysis: represent... __________ of any relationship → 전치사구(of any relationship)와 결합하여 동사(represent)를 수식하는 부사 자리. independent(형용사) → independently(부사)로 변환.

questions.passage: People seem to recognize that the arts are cultural activities that draw on (or __________) certain cultural traditions, certain shared understanding, and certain values and ideas that are characteristic of the time and place in which the art is created. In the case of science, however, opinions differ. Some scientists, like the great biologist J. B. S. Haldane, see science in a similar light — as a historical activity that occurs in a particular time and place, and that needs to be understood within that context. Others, however, see science as a purely "objective" pursuit, uninfluenced by the cultural viewpoint and values of those who create it. In describing this view of science, philosopher Hugh Lacey speaks of the belief that there is an underlying order of the world which is simply there to be discovered — the world of pure "fact" stripped of any link with value. The aim of science according to this view is to represent this world of pure "fact", independently of any relationship it might bear contingently to human practices and experiences.

det.korean: 예술은 특정 문화적 전통에 의존하거나 '반발하는' 문화 활동이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 홀데인 같은 과학자들은 과학을 '비슷한 관점으로' 본다 — 역사적 활동으로서.
det.analysis:

❌ ③ of any relationship — 어떤 관계의 (본문에 있으나 see science ___ 문법에 부적합)
❌ ④ within that context — 그 맥락 안에서 (본문에 있으나 see science ___ as와 어울리지 않음)
det.tip: in a similar light = 비슷한 관점으로, 비슷한 시각으로
